instruction: Cinematic full-shot film still of a bright indoor dance studio with wooden floors and large windows. On the left, the man in the blue 'VENICE' t-shirt and pink shorts (R2) is jogging in place with one leg raised, smiling down at his partner. Beside him on the right, the woman in the pink crop top and silver suspender unitard (R3) jogs in place with arms bent, looking down. They are exercising side-by-side in sync. Natural daylight streams from the background windows, creating a bright, cool-toned atmosphere with soft shadows.
